title: Remove or reconcile the dead LWW/merge-forward helpers in merge_rules.dart
rule: Dead code / Fowler speculative generality; Evans ubiquitous-language drift (file claims authority it no longer has)
why: A repo-wide grep shows lwwMerge, mergeForwardMaxInt, mergeForwardMaxDate, mergeForwardUnion and MergeResult are referenced only by test/features/sync/domain/merge_rules_test.dart and one story-acceptance test — no production merger calls any of them; the real LWW gate is DriftMergeStore.remoteIsNewer. The file's doc comment ('Conflict resolution rules for non-event-log data... These rules handle the rest') presents itself as the authoritative merge-rule library, misleading a reader when 12 of 13 LWW mergers actually moved to DriftMergeStore in the documented 'Phase 3' upgrade.
recommendation: Once StudyDayConfigMerger is migrated off this file's remoteIsNewer (see the paired finding), delete the unused functions/class and their now-orphaned tests, or correct the file's doc comment to state it is superseded/test-only.
acceptance_criteria: Post-fix grep confirms merge_rules.dart has zero production callers left; file is either deleted or its doc comment is corrected.
